name: Mind Your Prompt 🏆
desc: Winner, Assurant "Take Control of AI" Challenge at ShellHacks 2026. On-device PII detection for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini chats using BERT NER plus rules, with a Snowflake Cortex RAG pipeline for cited policy answers.

name: Quant Crucible 🏆
desc: Winner, MLH Best Use of ElevenLabs at Gator Quant Hacks 2026. Pre-registered quant study of whether liquidity providers are paid most when market fear (VIX) peaks, with a locked out-of-sample test.

name: MoneybackOS
desc: Built for SwampHacks 2026. Finds savings in purchases you've already made: imports Capital One Nessie transactions, extracts receipts with Gemini, monitors price drops and tracks refund and warranty deadlines in one dashboard.

name: OmniVec2 World Model
desc: Research at UF's TEA Lab: a multimodal Masked Autoencoder and world model fusing camera and LiDAR on nuScenes in PyTorch, trained across GPUs on the HiPerGator SLURM cluster with auto-resuming checkpoints.

name: Gator Game Room Assistant
desc: Agentic RAG assistant with a 4-route intent classifier and hybrid dense + BM25 retrieval, plus PII redaction, role-based access tiers and output guardrails. Passed 50/50 live LLM evaluation cases backed by a 127-test suite.

name: RecipeAI
desc: Full-stack RAG recipe recommender: SentenceTransformer embeddings in ChromaDB, ingredient-aware filtering and re-ranking, and Llama 3.1 70B explanations generated in parallel via FastAPI, with an Angular 17 front end.

name: AI Freezer Inventory Counter
desc: Mobile-first app where staff photograph a freezer and a vision-language model (NVIDIA NIM) counts every product, compares against the last scan to compute units sold and restock urgency, and sends a WhatsApp report.

name: NANO-VLM
desc: A lightweight vision-language model built from scratch in PyTorch: CNN image encoder and text encoder trained with a CLIP-style contrastive loss on a synthetic dataset, supporting text-to-image retrieval.

name: XAI for Diabetic Retinopathy
desc: Developed CNN, VGG, Vision Transformer and Swin Transformer models for diabetic retinopathy classification and integrated LIME for model interpretability and clinical decision support.

name: Emotion Recognition System
desc: Implemented a CNN-LSTM-based speech emotion recognition system using MFCC and mel-spectrogram features with data augmentation for improved robustness.

name: Vision Transformer
desc: Implemented a Vision Transformer (ViT) from scratch in PyTorch and trained it on the MNIST dataset.

name: Volleyball Team Manager
desc: Cross-platform Expo / React Native app with Supabase auth and row-level security, player management, and a balanced team generator using snake-draft distribution plus pairwise swap optimization, with PDF export.

name: Digital Storytelling App Using AI
desc: Built an AI-driven storytelling system using natural language generation and reinforcement learning to generate coherent and engaging narratives.

name: QR-Code Authentication System
desc: Designed a QR-code-based pipeline using Python and OpenCV to enable real-time authentication and automated email-based QR distribution.
